definition_en: a part of a tree that grows out from the trunk
core_image: 从树干斜伸出去的带叶枝条
scene: 春风里窗外的树枝轻轻摇动。The wind moved the branch outside the window.
sceneCN: 这里 branch 是「树枝」（第 1 个义项：从树干长出的部分）；句意是春风里窗外的树枝轻轻摇动。

pos.zh: 名词：树枝；分支；分支机构

senses.title: A part of a tree
senses.definition: a limb that grows out from the trunk of a tree
senses.example: The wind moved the branch outside the window.
senses.exampleCN: 春风里窗外的树枝轻轻摇动。
senses.why: This is the oldest sense, taken from the tree.
senses.whyCN: 这是最古老的义项，来自树木本身。

senses.title: A local office
senses.definition: a local office of a larger organization
senses.definitionCN: 较大机构在地方设立的分部
senses.example: She works at the bank's city branch.
senses.exampleCN: 她在银行的市区分行工作。
senses.why: A limb splitting from a trunk pictured a unit splitting from a centre.
senses.whyCN: 从主干分出的枝条，被用来比喻从中心分出的单位。

senses.title: A division of a subject
senses.definition: a part of a subject that has grown on its own
senses.definitionCN: 从大学科中独立出来的一部分
senses.example: Genetics is a branch of biology.
senses.exampleCN: 遗传学是生物学的一个分支。
senses.why: Knowledge was seen as a tree with separate limbs.
senses.whyCN: 知识被看作一棵长出不同枝条的树。

intro.en: Branch came from Latin branca, a paw, through French.
intro.cn: branch 经法语来自拉丁语 branca，本指爪子。

items.en: branca meant a paw or a claw.
branche named a limb of a tree.
branch named a division of a family.
branch covers trees, offices and subjects.
items.cn: 如今 branch 兼指树枝、机构与学科。

note.en: The look-alike group shares the br- opening; the near-meaning group gives limbs and divisions.
note.cn: 形近组都以 br- 开头；近义组是枝条与分支的说法。

entries.definition: a long seat for several people
a product name owned by a company
a large branch of a tree
a large branch or an arm or leg
a part of a larger whole

normalIntro.en: Branch starts at the trunk and grows outward.
normalIntro.cn: branch 从树干开始，向外生长。

normal.en: A branch grows from the trunk.
The bank opened a new branch.
Branch out means to try something new.
normal.cn: branch out 指尝试新事物。

normal.en: Genetics is a branch of biology.
normal.cn: 遗传学是生物学的一个分支。

abstract.en: See a limb splitting from a trunk.
abstract.cn: 想象一根枝条从树干分出。

abstract.en: See a small office far from the head office.
abstract.cn: 想象一间远离总部的办公室。

abstract.en: See a tree of subjects with many limbs.
abstract.cn: 想象一棵挂满学科的树。

examples.en: The wind moved the branch outside the window.
examples.cn: 春风里窗外的树枝轻轻摇动。

examples.en: She works at the bank's city branch.
examples.cn: 她在银行的市区分行工作。

examples.en: Genetics is a branch of biology.

dict_mnemonic.text: branch 里有 bran，像树皮粗糙的树干，ch 是抽出的枝条，一长一短就记住了树的分枝。

root: branch 经古法语 branche 来自晚期拉丁语 branca（爪子），由树木的枝条引申为家族、机构与学科的分支，核心始终是「从主干分出去的部分」。

sensesIntro.en: A limb of a tree and two kinds of division that copy it.
sensesIntro.cn: 一根树枝，以及两种模仿它的分支。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a leafy limb leaning out from a trunk.
core.cn: 核心意象：从树干斜伸出去的带叶枝条。

branches.en: a branch of an olive tree

intro.en: Branch forms adjectives and nouns with -ed and -ing.
intro.cn: branch 加 -ed 与 -ing 构成形容词和名词。

latinIntro.cn: 词基来自拉丁语，下面列出相关词形。
